_comment: Starter grocery catalog seeded per household on first boot (source='builtin'). Every entry is a single concrete grocery item. cmd/build_catalog may attach a freefoodphotos.com (CC BY 3.0) photo to an entry via image_source_url/image_attribution, but must not append photo-caption rows as items; run it with -enrich-only (now the default). The runtime image pipeline downloads and caches each photo lazily on first view.
